lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: Visitors sign in. Everyone signs in. The founder signs in, and he owns the pen, and the desk, and the building.

lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: The old lab? Back buildings, two hundred metres, straight past the planting. Nobody has an access reason for those any more. There is a form for it. Nobody has filled it in since I started, and I started six years ago.

lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: The ticker is allocation figures. I do not know what they mean and neither does anybody on this floor, including the people whose job I assume it is. It is calming, though. I watch it at lunch.

lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: There's a hold on the building today. Something about the senate. Nobody has told me what, and I asked twice on the first day, and I have stopped.
